name: Central South University
supervisors: Ministry of Education (co-built with SASTIND and the Hunan government)

evidence.summary: CASI identifies the national defence science and technology key laboratory for lightweight, high-strength structural materials, set up in 2005 under Central South University’s Powder Metallurgy Research Institute, whose lightweight alloys are used in aviation, aerospace, weapons, shipbuilding and the nuclear industry.
items: Defense S&T Key Laboratory of Lightweight, High-strength Structural Materials (轻质高强结构材料国防科技重点实验室)

evidence.summary: In January 2008 the Ministry of Education, COSTIND (the predecessor of the defence-industry regulator SASTIND) and the Hunan government signed an agreement to co-build Central South University, one of the first three Ministry of Education universities co-built with the defence-industry commission.
